subject: pol-dy
title: POL.DY.------PROG.CONT.
description: Chart 2 of 2 on book p. 293 (PR.S(RD)II-47). POL-DY (political dynamics) is the subject; PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) is the partner. From the subject: TRS (transition), SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics) and INFO-DY (information dynamics). From TRS: RT-DY (reality dynamics). From SOC-RT-DY: RT-ALGN (reality alignment). From INFO-DY: DOC (documentation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From RT-ALGN: PHY-U-P (physical universe particular). From DOC: RTD-PRD (related procedure). From PHY-U-P: POL-OR (political order).
